cases.statement: Within one market buying NO is selling YES; YES and NO positions net; same-market YES + NO is never structural arbitrage.
NO ask = 100c - best YES bid (and YES ask = 100c - best NO bid): one book, one liquidity pool.
Yankees YES and Rays NO are different markets with separate books, independently executable, prices may differ; the route may choose Rays NO when it is cheaper all-in.
